entries.zh: 做谜；出谜语、行猜谜游戏（西语"此物彼物"之戏）
entries.en: to pose a riddle; play the riddle-guessing game ('this thing and that thing')

entries.zh: 玩弄；戏弄、相互取笑
entries.en: to toy with; mock and make fun of one another
entries.notes: H 栏首字存疑（[疑:玩/敖]），西文词头后半残讹（otien=mientos 不可解）；据 M 栏 guân lāng 音合"玩弄"定释

entries.zh: 下棋；弈棋（西义兼指双陆等棋盘之戏）
entries.en: to play chess or board games; (Sp.) to play tables (backgammon)

entries.zh: 操练武艺；练习使用兵器
entries.en: to practise arms; drill with weapons
entries.notes: H 栏首字存疑（[疑:操/扯]）；M 栏 chaú Liēn 音合"操练"，据以定字

entries.zh: （宴席上）行令；行酒令之戏
entries.en: to play drinking games at a banquet; give the command in the drinking game

entries.zh: 六月（原档对西语 Julio，相当于公历七月）
entries.en: July (paired in the original with the Chinese sixth lunar month)
entries.notes: R 栏残缺故判低；L/H/M 三栏互证清晰（月份名，西语七月对农历六月）

entries.zh: 季夏；夏之末月（农历六月）
entries.en: the last month of summer (jixia; sixth lunar month)

entries.zh: 咸草；海边耐盐之草（可编织席、缆，对西语 junça 灯心草类）
entries.en: salt-marsh rush (Sp. junça); a brackish coastal sedge used for weaving mats and cordage

entries.zh: 五月（原档对西语 Junio，相当于公历六月）
entries.en: June (paired in the original with the Chinese fifth lunar month)
entries.notes: R 栏残缺故判低；L/H/M 三栏互证清晰（月份名，西语六月对农历五月）

entries.zh: 仲夏；夏季之中（农历五月）
entries.en: midsummer (zhongxia; the middle month of summer, fifth lunar month)

entries.zh: 聚兵备战；集结士兵开战
entries.en: to muster soldiers for war; assemble an army
entries.notes: H 栏空缺、M 栏音写（tāng cóy chú cún bè）难与汉字对应；据 L 栏与 R 栏（Juntar exercito）互证判中

entries.zh: 整队集兵；将兵器排列成阵
entries.en: to marshal arms in ordered array
entries.notes: H/R 栏空缺，M 栏残讹（含不可解之 bazenordinaria）；仅据 L 栏西义暂释，故判低

entries.zh: 合、佮；连接、相聚
entries.en: to join, unite with; come together
entries.notes: H 栏作"甲"，疑为"佮"之音借；R 栏残讹（~ Juntause conserbarre gy hoē）；据 M 栏 cab cā 之连接义判中

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔original corrupt; meaning uncertain〕
entries.notes: 西语词头残讹（banco de una junta sa un~ 不可解），M 栏夹杂西文（Juntar basura）且音写难定字，H/R 栏无助；仅"聚集杂物"大意可辨，不足定释

entries.zh: 拼合严密；对接齐整、严丝合缝
entries.en: to join closely; fit exactly, adjust just so
entries.notes: M 栏音写（Cā bā bā）无法对应确定汉字；据 L 栏西义（muy justo 甚密合）判中

entries.zh: 合；联合缔结（西注特指结为婚姻、缔结婚约）
entries.en: to join, unite; conclude a (marriage) contract

entries.zh: 着合；相合、合适（彼此贴合）
entries.en: to fit, suit; come together, adjust to one another
entries.notes: L/H 栏空缺；据 M 栏 tióhap（着合）与 R 栏 ajustarse 互证判中

entries.zh: 凑；凑集钱款、拼凑钱财
entries.en: to scrape together money; pool funds

entries.zh: 积；积聚储藏、囤积
entries.en: to gather and store up; accumulate, hoard
entries.notes: M 栏音写（ché chég chióg ché nó）难以逐字对应；R 栏另见聚集士兵字样（chāu sorrog soldados），两义并存待考，判中

entries.zh: 集；聚拢归一
entries.en: to gather into one

entries.zh: 聚；聚在一处
entries.en: to gather together
entries.notes: R 栏音写残讹（iguecap chū cháy）不影响判定，L/H/M 三栏清晰

entries.zh: 合计；总归为一
entries.en: to sum up, reckon together
entries.notes: M 栏中段残缺（quē [残] no）判低；L 栏与 H 栏"計"清晰，释义可从

entries.zh: 会；会合结伴（合伙结社）
entries.en: to come together in company; band together, form a partnership

entries.zh: 拱手为礼；合掌行礼（以礼相见）
entries.en: to join the hands as a courtesy; salute with joined hands
entries.notes: H 栏仅存"×"、M 栏末音节污损（T99）判低；释义据 L 栏"以礼合手"及 M 栏 chīú、háb 等可辨音节

entries.zh: 偕；两人相偕、彼此投合
entries.en: for two to come together; be in accord, conform
entries.notes: M 栏 cāy ió cām 仅首音节合"偕"音；R 栏残讹（conformarse, tiāng lâng inconuemiencia），判中

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔original corrupt; meaning uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 栏中段残缺（Juntar [残] con cabeza），H/R 栏空缺，M 栏 tān cáb būi 难以定字，语义无法定夺

entries.zh: 培土；拢土壅根护苗
entries.en: to bank up earth around plants; hill up soil with help
entries.notes: H/R 栏空缺，M 栏 pē cho hoe 仅首音节合"培"音，余字待考，判中
